title: Attorney General of Delaware

context.text: The Delaware Department of Elections' 2026 statewide general-election candidate list shows Kathy Jennings (Democratic) and David C. "Dave" Graham (Republican) for Attorney General. Phil Dyer Jr. is a declared write-in candidate; Delaware counts write-in votes only for declared write-in candidates.
Jennings won the September 15, 2026 Democratic primary with 71.1% over Dwayne Bensing and Patty Rickman. No Republican filed by the July 14 deadline; the Republican Party nominated Graham in August.

candidates.name: Kathy Jennings
candidates.ballotNote: Won the September 15, 2026 Democratic primary; seeking a third term.

priorities.text: Fighting federal policy in court: she says her office has sued the Trump administration more than 60 times.
Public safety, gun violence, victims' rights, election protection, civil rights and corporate accountability.
Consumer protection and corporate settlements, including housing-related work such as foreclosure prevention.

positions.summary: Said her office has gone to court to protect the right to abortion, nationally and in Delaware.
positions.quote: We've gone to Court to protect the right to abortion, both nationally and in our own state.

positions.summary: Said she has stood up to the NRA and passed gun safety policies that are now law.
positions.quote: I've stood up to the NRA, passing landmark gun safety policies that are now the law of the land.

positions.summary: Said her office's actions against the federal government "killed the tariffs."

record.text: Announced Delaware's participation in a multistate settlement with Meta; the state's release says Delaware will receive a guaranteed $73.6 million over ten years.
Announced a Delaware Supreme Court victory protecting permanent absentee voting.
Announced a $2.3 million settlement with Labcorp over the AMCA data breach by a coalition of 44 attorneys general; Delaware's share is $30,135.
Announced final approval of a $700 million multistate settlement with Google over its app store practices.

candidates.name: Dave Graham
candidates.ballotNote: Nominated by the Delaware Republican Party in August 2026 after no Republican filed by the July 14 deadline.

priorities.text: Delaware LIVE reports he is expected to emphasize military service, financial oversight, government accountability and responsible management.

candidates.researchNotes: No campaign website or direct policy statements were found.

researchNotes: Slate confirmed against the Delaware Department of Elections' official 2026 general-election candidate list and declared write-in list. Phil Dyer Jr. (declared write-in; Ballotpedia lists him as unaffiliated) is not on the printed ballot and has no entry. Jennings's 2026 official-action items were checked against the text of the State of Delaware release pages. Graham has no found campaign materials, so no positions are recorded; his biography rests on the Delaware LIVE article (dated August 26, 2026). No Delaware Secretary of State election appears on the 2026 candidate list (Ballotpedia lists Delaware as appointed by the governor).
